title: Magnet Mania 3D
description:
Magnet Mania 3D is a magnetism sandbox where you build, break, and rebuild until something spectacular happens.

Snap poles together. Fling objects across the lab. Rig pinball chaos. Import weird shapes into the sandbox and turn them into magnets that absolutely should not work but somehow do. 

What you do

• Experiment with north/south poles, fields, and materials until the chain reaction clicks

• Play through 25+ levels that teach real magnetic physics by making you fail forward

• Drop into Sandbox mode: import 3D objects, change materials, set objectives, and invent your own disasters

• Chase 9 achievements for builds that would make Tesla raise an eyebrow

Why it sticks Every mechanic is real magnetism dressed as a toy. Kids pick up science without a lecture. Adults stay for the “one more contraption” loop. Parents get the STEM win. You get the clip-worthy fails.

Colorful, readable, and built for short sessions or deep tinkering. Single-player. Family Sharing. Languages: English, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and more.

Stop reading. Build something that shouldn’t fly — then watch it fly.
description_short: Build wild magnetic machines, flip poles, and watch physics lose its mind. A chaotic magnetism sandbox for tinkerers, kids, and anyone who likes things that snap, fly, and fail spectacularly.
